listNote: The official 55 PS5 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are the official list exactly as published; kinds, counters, missable flags and the guides are this app's own work, derived from the wording of those descriptions.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list

trophies.guide: The platinum awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account, so there is nothing separate to grind for this one. Treat it as the finish line of the whole drive: story first, character strands second, then the collectible and activity miles. If your percentage stalls near the end, the 100% completion gold is almost always the missing piece.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it begins the moment you start a new game. Play through the introductory sequence, follow the movement and driving prompts as they are taught, and the trophy lands when the mission wraps up. It cannot be skipped or failed permanently, so settle in and enjoy the ride into Leonida.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1 of the story. Follow the mission markers as they appear and keep a reliable car and a full health bar for the scripted shootouts. No side content is required at all, so simply push the story forward until the chapter closes out.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 to earn this one. The chapter leans into the duo's first serious money-making schemes, so expect a mix of driving, stealth and shootout missions. If a mission keeps failing, swap vehicles between objectives to cool the heat and restock ammunition whenever you pass a gun store.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now both protagonists have settled into their routines, and missions start chaining longer drives across the map, so keep a fast personal vehicle ready for quick getaways. Finish the chapter's closing mission and the trophy pops during the wrap-up.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The stakes climb here, so go into missions with armour and snacks topped up and your favourite weapons upgraded. Work through the chapter objectives in order and the trophy is awarded as the chapter concludes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: This gold is for finishing the final story mission. Before you start it, make a manual save in a separate slot: endgame choices are the classic point of no return, and a backup save protects every strand you still have open. Play the finale through to the credits and the trophy unlocks as the story closes.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a one-time scripted mission, so when it becomes available, prioritise it over free-roam wandering to keep the story moving. Finish the run and its closing scene to bank the trophy.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the story's set-piece robberies. Heists reward a minute of preparation: arrive with armour, a fast four-door waiting for the escape, and your partner's abilities ready. Clear the score and escape the heat to finish the mission and earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears on your map. Like the other named story missions it only happens once, so drop a save beforehand if you like experimenting with approaches. See the mission through to its final objective and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Expect a loud, public set-piece: bring weapons suited to groups of enemies and use cover during the scripted waves. Finish the last objective and survive the escape to unlock it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a story mission built around the airport authority. Vehicle sections matter here, so grab something quick and sturdy when the mission starts moving. Complete the takedown and the trophy pops at mission end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late story operation. Go in stocked: full armour, an upgraded rifle and plenty of snacks for the long firefight stretches. Push through the operation's final stand and the trophy unlocks as it concludes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: The big gold: reach 100% completion on the game's stats page. That means the full story, every strand, all collectibles, activities, challenges and map exploration — essentially everything else in this guide. Track the number in the stats menu, and use this tracker's kind filters to hunt down whatever slice of percentage is still missing.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts — stunt jumps, flips and other marked feats of driving bravery. The fastest route is to chain the set-piece stunt jumps scattered around Leonida, since each clean landing counts and they can be re-attempted. Keep a durable sports bike or buggy handy, work region by region, and use the counter on this card to pace the grind.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once — there are 9 activity types in Leonida. You only need a single attempt at each, not a win, so tour the map icons: a race, a range challenge, a fishing spot and so on. Tick them off with the counter here and the trophy pops when the last new type registers.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total. Learn each lane's target pattern first with a relaxed run, then repeat it immediately while the rhythm is fresh. Accuracy bonuses matter more than raw speed on most lanes, so pace your shots instead of spraying.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 across the state. Drone races reward smooth lines over full throttle: ease off before tight gates so you do not clip the frame and bleed seconds. Learn each course with one practice run, then fly it clean for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Work through the race series on the map one by one, bringing a tuned vehicle in the right class for each. If a race keeps beating you, learn its shortcut lines in a practice attempt before going for the win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a test of patience: cast near the splashing spots, watch the line tension, and reel in short bursts rather than holding the reel down. Land the bigger haul before the timer ends and Cal hands you the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Cabinets sit in bars and arcades around the cities — walk up, start a game, and play it through to its end screen, win or lose. It only takes a few minutes, which makes this one of the easiest bronzes on the list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Stranger strands unlock in stages as the story progresses, so return to Andy's marker whenever a new one appears. Because this is his last job, finish the strand before you push into the endgame, and keep a save before starting it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Follow his markers through each stage of the strand as they unlock, and do not leave the finale hanging while you rush the main story. Once his last mission is complete, the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Billy's jobs appear progressively, so check the map for his icon after major story beats. Wrap up his last mission — ideally before the finale — and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a chain: finishing one mission for a stranger usually unlocks their next marker a little later in the game. Keep several strands moving in parallel, count finished strands here, and the silver pops at eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Randy's work is about moving product, so expect delivery and escort objectives — a sturdy vehicle makes the finale much calmer. Finish his last job before the endgame, just to be safe.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Work through his chain of missions as each new marker appears, and bring firepower for the finale. Completing his last mission unlocks the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 in all. These quiet spots sit on beaches, hilltops and overlooks, and each one only asks you to stop and use the prompt. Route them region by region with the counter here, ideally while exploring for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret points you at a one-of-a-kind quarry; track it through its territory, approach carefully, and line up a clean shot. Unique animals are tougher than regular wildlife, so bring a scoped rifle and some patience.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide in shops, bars and landmarks all over the state, and a set completes once you hold every card in it. Focus on one set at a time, sweep interiors thoroughly, and use the counter to track finished sets rather than loose cards.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a pure numbers grind: whenever you pass a fresh WAiNK spot, stop and use it, and let the counter here keep score. Pair the hunt with exploration and card collecting so the miles never feel wasted.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge lists. They range across driving feats, combat tasks and exploration goals, and most progress naturally while you work on everything else. Check the challenge menu for anything sitting one attempt away from done, and mop those up first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. Deliberately raise your wanted level to four stars with your partner in tow, then break line of sight and hide until the stars drain away. Rooftops, alleys and a quick vehicle swap all help the heat die down.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. Plan a short route of three nearby stores, keep the car running outside each one, and move fast so the stars never fully clear. The third robbery, finished with the heat still on, earns the trophy.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts when you get in and drive it for the first time. Rich districts, ports and airfields are showrooms of rare models, so go on a deliberate car-hopping tour. Use the counter here; you will likely pass 100 well before the map is fully explored.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up deliberately: find a group of at least five enemies, take a position with a clear view, then trigger Combat Focus and drop them all before it ends. A rifle with a large magazine makes the window far more forgiving.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, get out of the airport in a way the airport did not plan for. The opportunity is tied to the airport area and its story beats, so if you find yourself near VCIA with a way out in reach, try the impromptu exit. Keep a save before experimenting so a failed attempt costs nothing.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: The description is coy — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — but Rhinos are tanks, and this is about dealing with them. When a Rhino rolls out during high-heat encounters, either hijack it or disable it with explosives and heavy weapons. Survive the encounter and the trophy should pop; if it does not, repeat the trick with the next Rhino that shows up.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no brandished weapons in view of staff, no alarms, and an exit route planned before you start. Night-time, a disguise if the game offers one, and patience are your friends — if the alarm trips, reload and try a softer approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of free-roam crime: scout the bank, bring armour, stash a getaway car nearby, and crack the vault before the response arrives. Five clean escapes, tracked on this card, earn the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The trucks follow routes around the cities; ambush one in a quiet stretch, crack the rear doors with explosives or sustained fire, grab the cash, and vanish before the heat builds. A blocked side street makes the whole job easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every one of its 52 areas must be visited at least once. Most reveal themselves naturally through the story and collectibles, but remote islands and rural corners are easy to miss. Sweep the map region by region in a fast car or boat and count the areas off here.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — there are 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang's operation sits on its own turf, so tour the gang territories one by one. A single successful robbery per gang is all it takes; the counter here tracks how many you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a small one-off scene rather than a challenge: head to the Ocean Beach spots where drinks are served, order a cocktail, and take in the view. Moments like this can be tied to a point in your playthrough, so do it early, when you first reach the beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get inside a showroom, take one of the display cars, and drive it straight out through the glass. It is a deliberate set-piece moment — pick a fast car on the floor and aim for the windows.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through on the invitation — when the moment presents itself, go bowling. Visit the alley, start a game, and play it out. Series veterans will know the rule: when family suggests bowling, you say yes.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — points at a shared moment between the two protagonists. Progress the duo's story and their joint side activities, and take part when a partnership event with an audience appears. It is deliberately vague; keep doing partner activities and it will land.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Make choices — dialogue picks, mission approaches and story decisions all count, and the total runs to 500. Most choices come from simply playing: conversations, strand decisions and heist approaches. Because some choices only exist inside one-time missions, a thorough playthrough naturally racks up far more than a rushed one.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try — second time's the charm. Fail a task once, then complete it on the retry: a race, a challenge or a mission checkpoint all work. If you are too consistent to fail naturally, pick a tough stunt jump and let the first attempt go wrong on purpose.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — Leonida hides weird encounters out in its swamps and skies. Explore off the beaten path at night, especially around remote water and woodland, and investigate anything that looks out of place. When the game shows you something it refuses to explain, the trophy lands.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect. A motorcycle at moderate speed along a busy pavement is the classic setup. Aim for a glancing pass rather than a head-on hit so you stay on the bike.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from scores and robberies; instead of sitting on them, pass them to your laundering contacts whenever the option appears. It is a long accumulation, so start early and let the counter here track the clean total in thousand-dollar steps.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicle services, food, everything counts. You will pass this naturally while upgrading your arsenal and wardrobe for the endgame. If you are short late on, one luxury shopping spree in Vice City closes the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties on the map. Garages unlock for purchase as you progress and range from cheap lock-ups to premium spaces, so save up during the middle chapters. Buy them as your cash allows; the last purchase earns the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle you like, use the app's registration option to claim it instead of just driving off. Ten registrations is quick work if you make it a habit with every new car you take or buy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: Official PS5 trophy list — cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
